question: Why is the supreme Lord not bound by time and limiting factors in the non-difference view?
premises: For this view, the universe consists of the subject.
Likewise the subject consists of the universe.
The supreme Lord is not entangled by the nets and mire of time and limitation.
inference: Because subject and universe are mutually contained in the supreme Lord, time and limitation do not bind him.
plain_english: For those for whom the universe consists of the subject and the subject likewise consists of the universe, the supreme Lord is not entangled in the mire of the nets of time and limiting factors.
